english.title: Fail to provide evidence of security for a refund / repatriation in event of insolvency
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[organiser]_
(B)_[retailer]_
(C)_[organiser and retailer]_

of a contract, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONTRACT..), failed to provide sufficient evidence of security for the refund of money paid over and for the repatriation of a consumer in the event of insolvency
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 16(1) and (3) of the Package Travel, Package Holidays and Package Tours Regulations 1992.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.
INDICTMENT: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
